company.shortDescription: Pyn is a human resources company that helps companies to stay more engaged with their employees.
company.description:
Pyn is a human resources company that improves employee communications using marketing techniques, such as personalization, scheduling, and automated triggering. It specializes in the fields of employee engagement, human, employment, and training. 

Pyn improves employee communications using marketing techniques such as personalization, scheduling, and automated triggering.

Pyn’s employee-centric communication tool cuts through the clutter of messages in order to send only relevant and well-timed messages at key moments.

It was founded in 2019 and headquartered in Sydney, New South Wales.

productsAndServices.description: A solution to onboard and support sales and support teams with timely resources, coaching nudges, and performance data integration to improve ramp-up and ongoing performance.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $8,000,000, or 78.43% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $11,212,164 to $31,383,217, a 2.8x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
